description: REGTeches RC - Remote Connection Manager: SSH terminal, SFTP/FTP file manager, Remote Desktop, VNC, RustDesk, tunnels and live server status in one window
notes: Your servers, saved logins and settings are kept in $persist_dir and survive updates.
Start it from the Start Menu (REGTeches RC) or with the command: regteches-rc
The EXE is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Hash is verified by Scoop.
